# sonarqube_qualitygate (Resource)

A quality gate. Conditions are authoritative when at least one `condition` block is present; a gate created with `copy_from` and no blocks keeps the copied conditions unmanaged. Import ID: the gate name. An imported gate manages all its conditions, in metric order; list the `condition` blocks in that order to avoid a reordering diff after import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualitygate" "strict" {
  name = "Strict"

  condition {
    metric    = "new_coverage"
    op        = "LT"
    threshold = "80"
  }

  condition {
    metric    = "new_duplicated_lines_density"
    op        = "GT"
    threshold = "3"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Gate name. Changing it renames the gate in place.

### Optional

- `condition` (Block List) A gate condition. Metrics must be unique within a gate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--condition))
- `copy_from` (String) Name of a gate to copy on creation.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Make this the default gate. Unsetting it, or destroying the gate while default, makes the gate that was default before Terraform made this one default the default again, or the built-in gate when that one is unknown or gone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The gate name.

<a id="nestedblock--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Required:

- `metric` (String) Metric key, e.g. `new_coverage`.
- `op` (String) `GT` (fails above threshold) or `LT` (fails below).
- `threshold` (String) Error threshold, kept as written (`80` and `80.0` are different values). Ratings take `1` (A) to `5` (E).

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Condition ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualitygate.example 'Strict'
```
